label: Assessment
model: yi|theta_i ~ Binomial(Ni,theta_i); theta_i|mu,kappa ~ Beta(mu*kappa,(1-mu)*kappa); independent siblings, exchangeable new ES rate
reason: A Beta distribution has theta_ES>0 almost surely; infinitely many independent future trials then fail almost surely. This is a MODEL ARTEFACT, not evidence ES is false. The threshold 1e18 does no work in a stationary model.
nonidentifiability: An independent ES-specific zero-rate indicator has identical sibling likelihood under both states, so its prior is unchanged. Finite data do not determine decay/extrapolation of arithmetic failure probabilities; the siblings have incompatible domains and visibly nonstationary bins. No valid real-world P(ES false) is claimed.
